raw.raw:
minimum_runx: 0.12.0
methods:
  run:
    steps:
      - id: scan
        tool: fs.read
        inputs:
          path: README.md
      - id: review
        guard:
          - {value: $steps.scan.status, equals: needs_review}
        agent: review
        inputs:
          readme: $steps.scan.result
